caption:
Ending Lunar New Year the traditional way with a modern twist. 
Tongyuen (湯圓) is a traditional glutinous rice dessert we eat to celebrate reunion. It's traditionally shared with family on the 15th day of the Lunar New Year.

Because “yuen” sounds like reunion (團圓), it represents family and togetherness ♥️
I modernized this tradition into a cookie — same meaning, new way to share 🍪🧧

Hope those celebrating got to enjoy tongyuen in some form with their families! Traditional or modern!
